title: Mapped assets
summary: Roads, bridges, places, schools, health facilities, power infrastructure and water features mapped in OpenStreetMap.
method: Features selected by OSM tags from the Ghana extract, closed power ways converted to areas, and each asset assigned to a district by P-code. 1,296 assets in the pilot.
limitations: Completeness varies by place and type: a missing feature is not proof that it is absent on the ground.
Health facilities and power infrastructure are sparsely mapped in the pilot.
Only already-public OSM features are shown; no attempt is made to locate unmapped critical infrastructure.
